title: sirgas2000-utm: UTM ↔ latitude/longitude conversion for SIRGAS 2000
description: Open-source TypeScript library to convert UTM ↔ latitude/longitude in SIRGAS 2000 (GRS80), Brazil's official datum, with automatic zone, EPSG codes and Brazilian degree-minute-second parsing. Sub-millimetre accuracy (Krüger series after Karney, 2011), validated against proj4. Made by Phreatica (https://phreatica.com).
